name: BACH_0082
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (97%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Normal is the sole class in the 90% conformal set [F1], with full model and neighbor agreement.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 97%, InSitu 3%, Benign 0%, Invasive 0% | Strongly favors Normal over InSitu |
| Conformal set | Normal (alpha 10%; 90% dataset coverage, n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Passes QC; high OOD percentile |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Yes | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (79%–83% similarity) [F5] | All nearest neighbors match Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · Score +1.70 (contribution -1.70), but 0/20 spot check is unreliable [F2] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-1.34) on ↓-invasive concept yields +0.52 contribution [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 2, 7, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.15, contribution -0.43) supports non-invasive tissue [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Score +1.03 (contribution +0.41) despite 1% invasive risk in region 4 · Validated
- **HoVer-Net cell fractions** (regions 2, 7, 11) · context · Dead cells 18% (97th percentile, wrong-direction) [F8]; immune 7% (91st) [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions beat random removal (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); top driver **normal_lobules** (0/20 spot check) is unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Unusual image features (94th OOD percentile) mask focal in situ (3% probability) or benign changes (BACH_0361, 78% similar).
- Focal atypia exists in higher-risk regions 7 (7% risk) or 11 (4% risk, pleomorphism +1.13) despite whole-image pooling.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 11, 2**: Highest regional risk (7%, 4%, 2%), 9 neoplastic nuclei (region 2), and pleomorphism (+1.13, region 11).
2. **Region 4**: Highest validated tumor-infiltrating stroma score (+1.15); confirm normal lobules rather than stromal invasion.
3. **Regions 0, 4, 8, 9**: Verify normal lobules (unreliable 0/20 concept) and inspect ducts in region 9.
